material_definitions: The Li+ superionic argyrodites Li6PS(5-x)SexBr (0 		 x 		 1) have been synthesized to study the influence of increasing anion polarizability and replacing the free S2- site with Se2-.
The materials are solid solutions, confirmed by structural analysis showing linear increase in lattice parameters with increasing Se content (Vegard's law).
Ionic transport was measured using temperature-dependent electrochemical impedance spectroscopy.
The overall ionic conductivities are based on the total conductivity, which relates to bulk transport with an uncertainty of ~10%.
warnings: Raw temperature (25 C) is inferred as a standard representation of 'Room-temperature'. The specific composition 'x' yielding this maximum conductivity is not stated.
